LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 9.1.1 PRESENTATION SKILLS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills, part of Strand 9 in Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How can you hold an audience’s attention when making a presentation? 2. Why are all the Kenyan communities important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: This is promoted as the learner accumulates information when researching on how other Kenyan communities

say common greetings and words like thank you and welcome.

• Self-efficacy: The learner effectively prioritises tasks when making the presentation in class while engaging the audience

and applying the public presentation skills.

Values:
• Unity: This is promoted as the learner works jointly with peers to record the presentations.

• Responsibility: It is developed as the learner diligently prepares a short talk on the topic Kenyan cultures as a source of the

people’s pride.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Ethnic and Racial Relations: This is promoted as the learner conducts research on other Kenyan communities and seeks to

understand them better.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of public presentations to the concept of performance in Creative Arts and Sports.
